The player clicks on two identical tiles. If the line connecting them is no more than three zigzags (i.e., two turns), the connection is successful and the tiles are removed.

Rearrange button

Niti Rummy is a casual 13-card Indian Rummy practice game.

Game Rules:

• Each of the four players draws 13 cards from a standard 52-card deck.

• Designate one card as the wild card for the round.

• When it's your turn, draw a card from the face-up deck or the deck, then discard one card.

• Form at least two straights, at least one of which must be a straight (without the wild card).

• Complete the remaining hand with a straight or a flush (three of a kind or four of a kind).

• When you have all 13 cards, you declare yourself the winner of the round.

Scoring is based on practice points, calculated according to the remaining unpaired hands of your opponents. The first player to achieve the matching goal wins the round.

Niti Rummy is intended for adults aged 18 and over only and is intended for casual entertainment.

文字狂熱者： 鍾愛成語接龍、填字遊戲、解謎謎題的你。

美學愛好者： 想換個方式重新領略漢字線條之美、提升觀察力的各年齡層玩家。

Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
